## UI and Styling
- Follow the existing UI library and styling approach.
- Reuse existing design system components.
- Maintain consistent spacing, typography, colors, and layouts.
- Ensure responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop.
- Support accessible UI practices.
- Use semantic HTML elements.
- Add appropriate labels and accessible names to interactive elements.
- Ensure keyboard accessibility and visible focus states.
- Avoid inline styles unless required by the existing architecture.
